q: Pinsker's inequality relates total variation to KL divergence by:
exp: Pinsker's inequality: TV(P,Q) ≤ √(D(P||Q)/2), or equivalently TV(P,Q)² ≤ D(P||Q)/2. This gives a quantitative relationship between KL divergence and total variation, used in hypothesis testing and statistics to bound the probability of error.
